name: YouTrack Tasks
description: Lists your YouTrack issues in a sidebar panel and starts an agent on one in a new worktree.

settings.title: YouTrack URL
settings.description: Your YouTrack address, e.g. https://youtrack.example.com. /api is added when missing. The panel asks for it on first use.

settings.title: Issue query
settings.description: YouTrack search query for the issues the panel lists. The panel's "Assigned to me" checkbox adds for: me.

settings.title: Agent
settings.description: The agent Start launches in the new workspace.
